BiblicalUsage: When Elizabeth's neighbours hear she has named her son John, they say there is none of her kindred called by that name, and Stephen says Joseph sent and called his father Jacob to him, and all his kindred, seventy-five souls. Kindred is the circle you are born into, and God breaks into it with a name no one in the family carries.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God calls people by names their kindred never chose, and I believe His family is wider than the one I was born into.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
